title: Black Friday Maple Espresso Martini
description: An espresso martini with maple syrup for a Black Friday evening gathering.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: Ice and 3 coffee beans or cocoa dusting
instructions:
1. Brew espresso, cool for a few minutes, and chill a coupe glass.
  2. Shake vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso and maple syrup vigorously with ice for 15 seconds.
  3. Double-strain into the chilled glass and garnish.
notes: Use decaf espresso for a lower-caffeine version.
